submitted.rationale: Across 5 EQE measurements, index 13 (Sb 0.658) had the highest EQE at 0.134%. The response peaks on the Sb-rich side of the AgSbO3 composition (Sb 0.5): 0.061% at Sb 0.49, 0.134% at 0.66, 0.109% at 0.71, 0.029% at 0.81, and negative at 0.31. This fits AgSbO3 mixed with excess Sb oxide performing best. XRD was not used to confirm the phases.
